breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the factor-of-safety definition n = Sy / σ_avg (yield strength divided by working stress), with σ_avg in the denominator. It explicitly computes n = 275 MPa / 47.746 MPa ≈ 5.76, matching the ground truth. It also explicitly calls out and discards the incorrect reversed definition (n = σ_avg / Sy) that appeared in the incomplete prompt, ensuring the error is not propagated.
